memories.title: Delivery preference
memories.body: Before delivery, report the validation performed and unresolved limitations.

memories.title: Webhook retries duplicate charges
memories.body: The payment receiver processed a repeated event twice after a network timeout.

memories.title: Unique event receipt constraint
memories.body: Persist the event receipt and apply its side effect in one transaction. An existing receipt skips the effect.

memories.title: Retry safety for side effects
memories.body: Use the producer event identifier as the deduplication key. Validate repeated delivery and concurrent consumers.

memories.title: Calendar timezone boundaries
memories.body: Bookings use the venue timezone when determining midnight. Store instants in UTC and test daylight saving transitions.

memories.title: Accessible dashboard palette
memories.body: Use a dark slate background with distinct amber warning and green success colors. Icons and labels also distinguish states.

memories.title: SQLite WAL backup before migrations
memories.body: Use SQLite online backup for committed WAL data. Preserve identifiers and refuse unsupported newer schema versions.

memories.title: Stale inventory after stock adjustment
memories.body: Invalidate cached inventory after a committed stock adjustment. Test the next read returns the new quantity.

memories.title: Checkout keyboard audit
memories.body: Verify focus returns to the payment trigger after closing the checkout modal.

memories.title: Archived checkout keyboard audit
memories.body: Unrelated task record: checkout keyboard focus. Must not be recalled outside its task.
